sections.appearance: She has long shoulder-length blonde hair with slightly parted blunt bangs and low-tied sidelocks that are tied using red ribbons. She has also magenta eyes. Halo ==== Momoi's halo consists of two neon pink circles with four pointed kites on its rim directed inwards. Her halo is the same as Midori's, but with a neon pink color instead. Uniform ==== She wears a unbuttoned frilled multicolored white, black and pink hoodie with layered sleeves that hangs off her shoulders, a tucked-in collared white dress shirt with a blue tie and black suspenders, alongside a pleated white-accented black skirt with frills, black thigh high socks with white accents, and magenta floppy boots. She also wears a cat-eared headset with a neon pink color scheme. Midori has the same cat-eared headset except hers has a neon-green color scheme. Winter version: She wore a black-trimmed hooded jacket with white and pale purple accents, two zippers on each sleeve, and the Game Development Department logo. She also wore a white scarf and pale purple gloves, along with light gray tights and dark gray knee-high boots with white fur lining for warmth. Firearm ==== thumb|Unique Idea|150px She uses a bright red H&K (Heckler & Koch) G3A3 battle rifle with a crystal in place of the muzzle brake and beads as trigger guard. A green cat-like critter strap hangs on the trigger guard. A Game Development Club decal is stickered on the handguard.
